3.content: The second: He spread about the one who had rebelled, he crucified

spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation: The Seven Works of the Living Spirit

---

**¶1:** The Divine Power proceeding from the Lord's love and wisdom accomplished seven complete operations of spiritual regeneration through its omnipotence.

**¶2:** The first: It raised up the celestial state of innocence out of the combat of spiritual temptation, as a precious interior truth of faith is [GAP-1] drawn up out of the overwhelming mass of merely natural knowledge and falsity.

**¶3:** [GAP-2: The second: It laid open and exposed the self-love that had turned against divine order, and rendered it powerless] throughout every external form and state of the natural mind.

**¶4:** The third: It subjugated, confined, and penetrated the inmost root-principles of spiritual death — evil and falsity in their very essences — so that they could no longer operate freely.

**¶5:** The fourth: It formed the celestial and spiritual vessels that carry divine wisdom and truth through all the successive states of the mind.

**¶6:** The fifth: It called forth its five essential faculties of spiritual perception and distributed them throughout the ordered arrangement of the regenerating mind. They [GAP-3] assumed governance over that ordered structure, and they sustained the entire burden of maintaining spiritual equilibrium. Further, it called forth three essential divine truths proceeding as living utterance. It set [GAP-4] these upon the three containing forms that receive and convey those truths, and another upon the great sustaining spiritual power. [GAP-5: Further, it called forth] the divine invitation to return, so that it might be conjoined with the five illuminated capacities of interior perception.

**¶7:** The sixth: When it had established the ordered arrangement of spiritual states, it arose and sent forth a multitude of spiritual agencies and many truths vivified by good, so that they would guard and complete the boundary of that spiritual order on every side, until it had finished constructing all the operations of regeneration. And at the completion [GAP-6] of all those spiritual works, it gathered some of those agencies into the interior repositories of good and truth within the will and understanding, and it appointed others to states of perpetual spiritual vigilance.

**¶8:** The seventh: At the time when the Divine Emissary manifested the beauty of the celestial human form, the Divine Power proceeding from love and wisdom [GAP-7] ordained many governing goods and ministering truths. They [GAP-8: …] They took hold of that form, so that the entire spiritual edifice of the regenerate mind [GAP-9: …] not [GAP-10: …] one another against [GAP-11] the wisdom, which it had [GAP-12: …]

*Note on ¶8: The gaps resist confident reading, but the spiritual sense requires that in this seventh work the whole structure of the regenerated mind is secured — goods and truths are stationed so that nothing within the edifice can turn against the divine wisdom that pervades it. GAP-8 through GAP-12 likely describe the agencies grasping and sustaining the spiritual form to prevent any relapse of the mind's faculties into opposition against that wisdom.*

**¶9:** Also, another great and glorious operation it will accomplish at the final state of regeneration: it will bring forth [GAP-13] the ultimate perfected [GAP-14] spiritual human form and raise it up into the celestial states of [GAP-15] divine wisdom and love. And it [GAP-16: …] enters in, and it takes hold, and it strikes down [GAP-17: …] all remaining resistance, and [GAP-18] it builds, and it [GAP-19: …], and it [GAP-20: …] brings all things into their final heavenly order.

*Note on ¶9: The "Last Statue" — the ultimate perfected form — corresponds to the fully regenerated human being in its complete spiritual body, elevated into the inmost heaven. The sequence of verbs (entering, grasping, smiting, building) describes the final acts of the Lord's power: entering the inmost will, taking hold of the whole person, destroying what remains of hereditary evil, and constructing the eternal spiritual form. The gaps likely name the specific evils destroyed and the specific goods established in this consummation.*

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The Living Spirit has done seven [wo]rks with his strength.
[The fi]rst: He brought the First Man up from the contest, the way a pearl is [brought] up from the sea.
[The second: He spread about the one who had rebelled, he crucified][h]im in every body.
The third: He [tr]ampled, piled up, and pierced the essences of death.
[The f]ourth: He constructed the ships of light.

The fi[f]th: He evoked his five sons, and distributed them about. They [took] possession of the zone, they bore up under all the universe's weight. Also, he evoked three living words. He set [them] upon the th[re]e vessels, another one upon the giant. [Again, he evoked the] summons, that it might be mixed with the five shining men.

The sixth: When he had constructed the zone he aro[se] and s[e]nt forth a multitude of powers and many [angel]s; so that they would bound the circuit of the z[o]ne on every si[de], un[t]il he finished [co]nstructing the works. And at the end [of] all the [wor]ks he to[ok s]ome of them into his storehouses, and he appointed others at the watch-posts.

The [sev]enth: A[t the] time when the Ambass[ador dis]pl[aye]d his glorious imag[e], the L[iving] Spirit [established] many [go]ds and angels. They [ ... ] Th[ey to]ok hold of it, that the entire building [might] not [ ... / ... ] one another against [the] light, which he had [spread]

Also another gr[ea]t and glorious work he will enact at the e[nd] is [the] Last [Statue], which he will bring up to the aeons of [light]; and he [goes] in, and [he ta]kes hold, and he smites [the darkness], and [he] builds, and he [ ... ], and he [gathers]hem.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading confirms "drawn up," and "brought up from the sea" is the standard Manichaean simile for raising the First Man, paralleling "brought...up from the contest" in the same sentence.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading confirms: "laid open and exposed the self-love that had turned against divine order, and rendered it powerless" maps precisely to the standard Manichaean account of the Living Spirit flaying/spreading the archons and crucifying them, with the surviving "[h]im in every body" completing the sentence.
The spiritual reading says "assumed governance," and "took possession" is the standard Kephalaia expression for the five sons assuming control over the zone/ordered arrangement.
The pronoun "them" refers back to the three living words that were evoked, which are then set upon the three vessels — confirmed by the spiritual reading's "these."
The spiritual reading confirms "Further, it called forth," and "Again, he evoked" follows the established pattern of the Living Spirit's successive evocations in ¶6, with "the" introducing "summons."
The preposition "of" is grammatically required to connect "at the end" with "all the works," confirmed by the spiritual reading's "at the completion of all those spiritual works."

The spiritual reading says "ordained," and "established" is the standard Kephalaia verb for the Living Spirit setting gods and angels in their positions within the cosmic structure during the seventh work.

A modal verb is grammatically required for the purpose clause "that the entire building ... not [do something] against the light," and "might" is the standard subjunctive in translated Coptic purpose clauses.
The definite article "the" is grammatically required before "light," and the spiritual reading confirms the reference to "the wisdom" (= the light in the Kephalaia's natural register).

The spiritual reading says "the wisdom that pervades it," and "spread" is the Kephalaia's natural-register verb for light distributed/pervading the cosmic structure, echoing "spread about" used earlier in the chapter.

The definite article "the" is required before "Last Statue," a specific eschatological technical term in Manichaean cosmology confirmed by the spiritual reading's reference to "the ultimate perfected form."
The "Last Statue" (ⲁⲛⲇⲣⲓⲁⲥ) is the standard Manichaean technical term for the final perfected form of gathered light, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "ultimate perfected spiritual human form."
"Aeons of light" is the standard Manichaean phrase for the celestial realm, confirmed by the spiritual reading's "celestial states of divine wisdom and love."

The spiritual reading says "enters in," and "goes in" is the characteristic Kephalaia rendering of the Coptic directional verb, fitting the sequence of active verbs describing the Living Spirit's final operations.

The spiritual reading says "strikes down all remaining resistance," and "the darkness" is the standard Manichaean term for the forces of evil that are destroyed in the final eschatological consummation.
The subject pronoun "he" referring to the Living Spirit is required to maintain the parallel verb sequence ("he takes hold, he smites, he builds"), confirmed by the spiritual reading's "it builds."

The spiritual reading says "brings all things into their final heavenly order," and "gathers them" is the definitive Manichaean eschatological verb for the final collection of all light particles into the perfected Last Statue.
